response.sql: WITH timing_avgs AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS timing_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS ownership_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals) SELECT AVG(t.timing_avg) AS mean_ownership, AVG(t.timing_avg - o.ownership_avg) AS mean_above_average FROM timing_avgs AS t CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o WHERE t.timing_avg > o.ownership_avg;

assumptions.assumption: “Above average” means above the average institutional ownership across all records with a nonmissing ownership value.

alternatives.interpretation: “Above average” means above the equally weighted mean of the timing groups’ averages.
alternatives.sql: WITH timing_avgs AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS timing_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(timing_avg) AS ownership_avg FROM timing_avgs) SELECT AVG(t.timing_avg) AS mean_ownership, AVG(t.timing_avg - b.ownership_avg) AS mean_above_average FROM timing_avgs AS t CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE t.timing_avg > b.ownership_avg;
